ep6-absurdist-1.speaker: Clancy
ep6-absurdist-1.text: I was in a flooded basement snorting cocaine with strangers when a neighbor brought us that Pie Messiah.

ep6-absurdist-2.speaker: Clancy
ep6-absurdist-2.text: Actually, It's not even supposed to be ovenable. Not sure if that's a word.

ep6-absurdist-3.speaker: Clancy
ep6-absurdist-3.text: What does the kind of wobble do that's pee-pee yellow and creeping up behind you?

ep6-philosophical-1.speaker: David
ep6-philosophical-1.text: If you're caught up in your story, it's like living in a tiny apartment with just enough room for you and your little mattress.

ep6-philosophical-2.speaker: David
ep6-philosophical-2.text: The moment you get a little space between yourself and your thoughts, it's like moving into a much bigger house. Then there's room to invite people in.

ep6-philosophical-3.speaker: Clancy
ep6-philosophical-3.text: It seems more like it's accepting there's this infinite swarm of thoughts and that by understanding that you're not necessarily as connected to them as you thought, it allows...

ep6-conclusion-1.speaker: Captain Bryce
ep6-conclusion-1.text: I finally have time to really think about things, you know? Gives me a whole new perspective.
